items.headline: Running Claude Code fully offline on a MacBook — no API key, no cloud, 17s per task
items.summary: I wanted to share something I've been working on that might be useful for folks who want to use Claude Code without burning through API credits or sending code to the cloud. I built a small Python server (~200 lines) that lets Claude Code talk directly to a local model running on Apple Silicon via MLX. No proxy layer, no middleware — the server speaks the Anthropic Messages API natively. Why this matters for Claude Code users:  Full Claude Code experience (cowork, file editing, projects) running

items.headline: Offloading LLM matrix multiplication to the AMD XDNA2 NPU on Ryzen AI MAX 385 : 43.7 t/s decode at 0.947 J/tok
items.summary: Built a custom llama.cpp backend that dispatches GEMM ops directly to the XDNA2 NPU on Ryzen AI MAX 385 (Strix Halo). No iGPU and no shared memory contention. Model: Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct Q4_K_M  Hardware: Ryzen AI MAX 385, CachyOS 6.19, amdxdna driver, XRT 2.21.75 2.21.75 Results   Backend Prefill (t/s pp512) Decode (t/s tg64) Avg Power J/tok    Vulkan prefill + NPU decode 930 43.7 41.5 W 0.947   Vulkan only 833 41.6 52.2 W 1.3   CPU only 4.6 3.76 — —   The NPU decode path saves ~10W vs Vu

items.summary:
